_comment: THE NEGATIVE CONTROL FOR MTG_COMBO_OFF_DIG_COLOR -- the same board, and no colour to dig to.
edf_co_24's board exactly (Conservatory+Overgrowth, Brushland, Emiel the Blessed, two
Peregrine Drakes; not one blue or black source, a live {4},{T} Investigate, net +1 with
net_c +1), the same six filler cards under the top, and the library still holds the Living
Wish -- but every any-colour land Aura has been removed from it.
The lever is ON here (it is the shipped default since Session 24), which is the whole point:
the widening must find a colour that is REALLY reachable. With no Fertile Ground and no Trace
of Abundance anywhere, the board can never pay Dimensional Infiltrator's {1}{U} or Essence
Depleter's {2}{B}, so UB stays false, FinishNeedMana keeps refusing both finishers on colour,
ScanHandSinks prices nothing, FlickerGoOffCount sizes nothing -- and the button must be ABSENT.
The EXECUTOR half is controlled here too, and it is why this fixture survives Session 24
unchanged in verdict: DeployLandAuraFromHand can only cast an aura that SUPPLIES the missing
colour and is actually in hand, so on this board it returns at its first line every iteration.
Without this control, edf_co_24 would pass equally well on a rule that had simply stopped
